description: This Java source file defines a specialized exception class, ThingUnavailableException, used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It models a specific runtime exception indicating that a referenced 'Thing' is temporarily unavailable, providing various constructors and builder pattern support for creating instances with detailed context.

classes.name: ThingUnavailableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception indicating that a Thing resource is currently unavailable. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, providing static factory methods and a nested builder class for flexible creation.

classes.name: ThingUnavailableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class implementing a fluent API for constructing instances of ThingUnavailableException with custom headers, messages, descriptions, causes, and links.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ThingUnavailableException instance with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ThingUnavailableException instance based on a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified DittoHeaders, preserving other properties.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder initialized with a specific ThingId for customizing exception creation.
